specs.anchorText: the teacher's full output distribution carries more information than the hard label alone
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background: a large wise owl teacher in a graduation cap pointing at a picture of a husky dog on a blackboard, leaning toward a small eager student robot at a desk. Instead of saying only one answer, the owl whispers a gentle gradient of hints shown as three soft speech bubbles of decreasing size containing tiny dog, wolf, and malamute silhouettes, and a faint barely-there teapot silhouette far away. The small student robot nods, absorbing the nuanced ranking of plausible answers, not just the single correct one. Warm and friendly comic-strip style, expressive characters, minimal clutter, generous margins, suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle, immediately understandable humor. One clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A wise owl teacher whispers a husky picture's full ranking of plausible answers (dog, wolf, malamute, faintly teapot) to a small eager student robot, illustrating how distillation transfers the teacher's soft probability distribution rather than just the single correct label.
specs.caption: The teacher does not just say what the answer is; it reveals what the wrong answers nearly were, and that ranking is the dark knowledge a small student cannot learn from labels alone.

specs.anchorText: The interchange format means you export once and deploy many places
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background: a friendly robot model packing itself into a single neutral shipping crate at a small post office (the portable graph), and the crate then traveling along three forking conveyor belts to three different specialized workshops. Each workshop has a distinct character craftsman tailoring the same crate's contents to fit a different machine: one tuning it for a powerful GPU tower, one fitting it onto a desktop CPU box, one shaping it for a small mobile gadget. The single crate, many destinations idea is clear and cheerful. Warm friendly comic-strip or XKCD-inspired style, expressive characters, minimal clutter, generous margins, suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle, immediately understandable humor. One clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A robot model packs into one neutral shipping crate that travels forking conveyor belts to three workshops, each craftsman tailoring it for a GPU tower, a CPU box, or a mobile gadget, illustrating exporting once to ONNX then compiling per hardware target with TensorRT, OpenVINO, and mobile runtimes.
specs.caption: Export once into a portable crate, then let each hardware target's compiler tailor the contents; the trip that knows the chip by name is the part that makes it fast.

specs.anchorText: watts and milliwatt-hours are as hard a constraint as accuracy
specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background: a small thrifty robot sitting in a tiny solar-powered cabin in the wild, carefully balancing on a see-saw scale. On one side of the scale sits a plump cloud labeled by a fluffy shape (representing accuracy), on the other side sit four small weights shaped like a battery, a memory chip, a stopwatch, and a thermometer (power, memory, latency, heat). The robot is gently juggling to keep all four small weights from tipping while a single drop of battery energy is precious. The robot looks considerate and careful, sipping from a tiny battery like a thermos. Cozy outdoor edge setting, warm comic-strip style, expressive characters, minimal clutter, generous margins, suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. Gentle, immediately understandable humor. One clear visual metaphor.
specs.alt: A thrifty robot in a solar-powered cabin balances a see-saw between a fluffy accuracy cloud and four small weights shaped like a battery, memory chip, stopwatch, and thermometer, while sipping precious battery energy, illustrating the edge budget of accuracy traded against power, memory, latency, and thermal headroom.
specs.caption: At the edge a model is judged on four constraints at once, power, memory, latency, and heat, and the design game is delivering the most accuracy per joule on a chip you do not control.

specs.alt: A roomy bus driven by a friendly GPU character waits a few seconds at a stop, shown by a small hourglass, so several little parcel-passenger requests board together rather than the bus making wasteful single-passenger trips, illustrating dynamic batching trading a little latency for much higher throughput.

specs.alt: A robot in summer sunglasses confidently gives a thumbs-up beside an all-green dashboard, oblivious that behind it the wall was repainted, snow fell, and a passerby now wears a mask, illustrating silent accuracy decay where a deployed model stays confident while the world drifts and no metric raises an alarm.
